verdict.rationale: Postman supports webhooks for event-driven integrations, pre-request/post-response scripts, and CI/CD triggers via CLI/API, which provide some event-triggered automation, but there is no evidence of a general-purpose rules engine where AI-native users can define arbitrary 'if event X then action Y' automations across the platform. missing for 10: a documented rules/trigger builder or workflow automation engine tying arbitrary events to arbitrary actions, first-party or independent evidence of such automation working end-to-end, and any AI-specific event-trigger interface beyond scripting/webhooks/CI integration.
